title: feat(cli): add an interactive configuration wizard to init
problem: `init` writes a static template, so users must edit TOML by hand to get a useful first configuration.
why: A guided setup produces a working configuration in seconds and teaches the options.
scope: Add an opt-in `--interactive` mode that asks about severity, categories, and excludes, then writes the file.
guidance: Keep non-interactive behavior unchanged; never prompt when stdin is not a TTY.
acceptance: Interactive flow documented and tested with scripted input
tests: CLI test driving the wizard through stdin
security: Do not write outside the target directory; respect `--force`.

title: feat(cli): add rules markdown export for documentation
problem: The rule catalog table in the docs is maintained by hand and can drift from the code.
why: Generating the table from metadata keeps documentation accurate.
scope: Add `rules --format markdown` that emits the catalog table.
guidance: Match the existing docs table format so it can be pasted or generated in CI.
acceptance: Markdown output tested and usable in the docs
tests: CLI test asserting the header and a rule row

title: docs(dx): add an editor integration specification (LSP) spike
problem: There is no path for editor integration, and the effort is large enough to need a design first.
why: In-editor findings are the highest-leverage developer experience improvement.
scope: Write a spike document covering an LSP or diagnostics-file approach, scope, and reuse of the core library.
guidance: Prefer a minimal diagnostics provider over a full language server.
acceptance: Resulting tasks filed as separate issues
security: The editor integration must never execute scanned code.

title: docs(dx): add a workflow and CI snippets gallery
problem: Users must assemble workflows from prose, which slows adoption.
why: Copy-paste snippets reduce mistakes and showcase capabilities.
scope: Add `examples/workflows/` with GitHub Actions, GitLab, and Makefile snippets.
guidance: Keep snippets minimal and link to the full reference.
